text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On one of our days off, Wonder Acute
and I visit
the zoo together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho. Would you look at all these
people! It's
so lively.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Why don't we follow the crowd
for now?
choice_data_list: どこから回っていこうか？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We surrender ourselves to the flow of
people for
a while, until Wonder Acute
suddenly stops in
place.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me... I could just pinch those
little
cheeks all day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her gaze and spot some
capybaras
relaxing by the water's edge.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't they look so calm and peaceful
just staring
like that? I wonder if they're
sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It warms my heart just looking at them... Although, now I'm feeling a little drowsy myself... Yaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Acute, you good? You look like
you're
'bout to conk out!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Huwah?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder you're getting sleepy,
though.
Look at those little cutie-pies.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
More like I saw Acute giving off
Sleeping Beauty
vibes and got worried.
choice_data_list: 君たちもカピバラを見てたのか？
貴方たちもカピバラを見てたの？

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well, I appreciate the concern.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's just something about these little
fellas I
kind of relate to. I could just sit
here and watch
them all day...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And she's out!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If ya like 'em so much, why don't I
get a
gagworthy pic of you with them?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I don't want to make anyone gag, but I would appreciate a picture.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be! What a wonderful
photograph! Don't
you think we look
like twins?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real! You're both so freakin'
adorable! This
pic is giving me life. Like,
literally.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's what?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She means that looking at it makes her happy. It definitely makes me feel warm and fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real, for real! Straight to
Umastagram it goes.
Is it cool if I post
this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the Umastagram thingamajig that
everyone
talks about! By all means!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! What should we do for filters? Deck
it out?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I think it might be better to leave it
natural.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I agree. The capybara is already cute as
a button.
choice_data_list: ありのままを見せよう

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone will be able to enjoy its

heart-warming charm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Comments are already pouring in!
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Be still my heart!" "This is giving me
life!" "This
made my whole week!"
They're loving it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Looks like everyone feels the
same way.
Well done.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. If people are feeling lively,
then I'm
happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The photo of Wonder Acute with a
capybara
proves highly popular among
those seeking a
dose of cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. If we're using Umastagram, we
may as
well use all the bells and
whistles.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I got you, girl! Wait till you see this glow
up.
You're so gonna gag!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Comments are already pouring in!
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"This is too precious! Straight to the save
folder!
Keep it up, Acute!" They're
loving it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sure looks that way. Actually, I've never
seen this
side of Acute, either. It's a bit
shocking.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that was quite fun. I wonder if I
could get
another glow-up someday?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The surprising picture of Wonder Acute
is very
well received.
